channel.title: DrDreams: studying medicine in the Philippines
channel.description: Pages on MBBS in the Philippines for Indian students: fees, NMC-listed colleges, documents, visa, FMGE and daily life. Written by Dr. Nitz.

item.title: Study MBBS in the Philippines: Fees, Colleges, NMC Rules (2027)
item.description: What MBBS in the Philippines costs, which colleges India's NMC lists, the documents, the visa steps and what FMGE takes. Checked against NMC notices.

item.title: MBBS in the Philippines: Complete Guide for Indian Students (2027)
item.description: The full route: the MD degree, NMC recognition, fees, NEET and the BSBio year, admission, the student visa, FMGE and what daily life is like.

item.title: Medical Colleges in the Philippines for Indian Students (2027)
item.description: Six NMC-listed medical colleges in Cebu, Manila and Davao, compared on fees, hospital exposure, batch size and FMGE coaching. With the cons included.

item.title: NMC Rules for MBBS in the Philippines (2026) and Validity in India
item.description: The NMC public notice of March 2026, the 54-month rule, the internship clause, and the checks that decide whether a Philippine MD is valid in India.

item.title: Philippine Licensure Exam (PLE) for Indian Graduates (2027)
item.description: How Indian graduates of Philippine medical schools can sit the Physician Licensure Examination, how the licence is obtained, and why it does not replace FMGE.

item.title: From India to Campus: Documents, Student Visa and Arrival
item.description: The full process for Philippine medical admission: the college file, the 12-item 9(F) visa checklist, authentication, the 20 to 25 day visa window, and arrival.

item.title: MBBS in the Philippines Fees: What Five Years Really Cost (2027)
item.description: Tuition, hostel, food, flights, visa renewals and FMGE coaching: the full cost of a Philippine MD, with the 2026-2027 fee sheets and the lines families miss.

item.title: FMGE, NExT and After the MD: The Full Sequence (2027)
item.description: FMGE and NExT explained, a year-by-year study plan, the Indian internship, registration, PG, jobs and the Philippine licence, in the order they happen.

item.title: Life in the Philippines for Indian Students (2027)
item.description: What daily life costs and feels like in Cebu, Manila and Davao: food, rent, safety, the accent, homesickness, and the first month after you land.

item.title: Life Outside Studies in the Philippines: Food, Weekends, Travel
item.description: What the week looks like when you are not studying: food, weekends in Cebu, festivals, sport, travel on a student budget, and how to keep it from eating the degree.

item.title: Study Resources for MBBS in the Philippines: MD Books by Year
item.description: First, second and third year MD book folders for Indian students in the Philippines, plus the subject map, a weekly study system and how to use Indian books alongside Philippine lectures.

item.title: MBBS in the Philippines: 20 Questions Students Ask (2027)
item.description: Short answers on cost, duration, NMC validity, NEET and BSBio, safety, the visa, FMGE, the PLE, and what happens if you fail a subject.

item.title: MBBS in the Philippines vs Other Countries: Cost, Language and FMGE
item.description: Philippines vs Nepal, Russia, China, Georgia, Kazakhstan and Uzbekistan on language, clinical access, total cost and FMGE. With the trade-offs.

item.title: About DrDreams and Dr. Nitz, and How to Get in Touch
item.description: Who writes DrDreams, how each page is checked and dated, and how to send a correction or a question. Written by a 2025 Southwestern graduate.

item.title: Terms of Use, Privacy and Disclaimer
item.description: The terms for using DrDreams, what the site does with your data, and the limits of the information it publishes. Written in plain English.
